name: Sunshade Awning Gazebo
description: Create a shady haven outdoors while preventing the harsh sunlight from heating up your indoors or fading furniture near windows or patio doors. This awning-style gazebo is freestanding, so it's easy to use and won't mess up your siding through mounting. Plus, it can easily be moved. Hook and loop strips make removing the fabric shade easy. Comes with 8 anchoring stakes. Assembly required. Gazebo is designed for occasional use, not as a permanent yard fixture. 10' w x 6' 9 1/2 h x 8' 5 d.
